meta.description: Designing smooth transitions between agents and between AI and humans.

copy.tagline: 设计智能体间及人机间的顺畅交接流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建多智能体系统或需要设计人机交接流程
copy.tagline_en: Design smooth handoffs between agents and between AI and humans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building multi-agent systems or designing human-AI handoff flows

howto.what: Claude能协助你设计AI助手之间或AI与人类之间的任务交接方案，包括定义触发条件、传递信息、确认机制和用户体验，以降低上下文丢失风险。
howto.when: 当你需要规划多AI系统任务流转、从AI转人工，或分析现有交接流程时触发。

say.text: 设计一个顺序交接：代理A完成后交给代理B。
say.note: Claude会给出包括负载和确认的详细步骤。

say.text: 帮我创建上下文传递模板。
say.note: Claude提供全量、摘要、结构化等选项。

say.text: 列出交接的反模式及对策。
say.note: Claude会分析黑盒、回音室等常见问题。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you design handoff protocols between AI agents or AI and humans, including triggers, context transfer, acknowledgments, and user experience, to reduce context loss.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to plan task transitions in multi-agent systems, handoffs from AI to human, or analyze existing handoff processes.

say_en.text: Design a sequential handoff: Agent A completes then passes to Agent B.
say_en.note: Claude provides steps including payload and acknowledgment.
Claude offers full, summary, structured options.
Claude analyzes black hole, echo chamber, etc.
